careInstructions:
Care Instructions
Melton Wool
Care for your melton wool varsity jacket like a suit, not a hoodie. Brush off dust after each game or class. Spot clean marks with cool water and a tiny bit of wool soap. If it needs a wash, use cold water, gentle motion, and short time. Lay the jacket flat on a towel and shape the ribs and cuffs while damp. Keep it away from heat and strong sun.

Do: Use a soft clothes brush after wearing.
Do: Air the jacket in shade, not sun.
Do not: Machine wash on heavy cycle or use bleach.
Do not: Tumble dry or hang it soaking wet.
Full-Grain Cowhide Leather
Treat your cowhide leather varsity or bomber jacket like real skin. Wipe it with a soft dry cloth after wearing. For light spots, use a damp cloth and mild leather cleaner only. Let the jacket dry at room temperature, away from heaters and windows. Condition a few times a year so the leather stays strong and smooth.

Do: Store on a wide hanger to keep the shoulder shape.
Do: Use a trusted leather conditioner when the leather feels dry.
Do not: Machine wash, soak, or wring the jacket.
Do not: Dry it in direct sun or near a heater.
Quilted / Polyester Linings
Quilted polyester linings sit inside varsity, bomber, and puffer jackets. They add light padding and need gentle care. Turn the jacket inside out so the lining is on the outside. Wash in cold water, gentle cycle, and mild detergent. Avoid long, hard spins so the fill stays even. Shake the jacket after washing to spread the padding, then hang to dry.

Do: Smooth the lining by hand while it is still damp.
Do: Store the jacket fully dry to prevent odor and mildew.
Do not: Twist or wring the quilted parts.
Do not: Use high dryer heat, which can damage the fill.
